steps.en: A badly formatted notice number is flagged with an error
steps.id: Nomor notice dengan format salah ditandai dengan error

steps.en: An uploaded notice that does not exist is reported
steps.id: Notice yang diunggah tetapi tidak ada akan dilaporkan

steps.en: A notice with nothing to revive is rejected, but only after Select
steps.id: Notice tanpa yang bisa direvive ditolak, tetapi baru setelah Select
steps.why_en: The message appears only after Apply Revival is chosen; a failed check leaves a blank page.
steps.why_id: Pesan baru muncul setelah Apply Revival dipilih; pengecekan yang gagal menyisakan halaman kosong.

steps.en: An empty search shows only a generic text
steps.id: Pencarian kosong hanya menampilkan teks umum
steps.why_en: Only the generic text No records to display appears; there is no revival-specific message.
steps.why_id: Hanya teks umum No records to display yang muncul; tidak ada pesan khusus revival.
